snippet.title: Like a Dragon: Kenzan! English Patch Trailer & Download
snippet.description:
After almost two years of this project being worked on, it's finally almost here!
I'm very glad I got to be part of the amazing team working on it, and I hope you all enjoy the game!

Download: https://www.moddb.com/mods/ry-ga-gotoku-kenzan-english-translation-patch
